name: Security, Privacy and Compliance
scope_from_master_specification: Tenant isolation; RBAC/MFA; password/session security; encryption; API auth/rate limits; brute-force/CSRF/XSS/SQLi protections; secure uploads; device/session revocation; audit; retention/export/deletion/consent; encrypted backups; vulnerability/dependency scans; penetration tests; incidents/alerts; Kenya Data Protection Act and GDPR where applicable; enhanced health/finance controls.
